## What changed

Describe the user-facing change and why it belongs in this plugin.

## Verification

List the checks and real workflows you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and easy to review.
- [ ] `npm run check`, `npm run test:coverage`, and `npm audit` pass.
- [ ] I tested the affected Herdr and Blaxel workflow when runtime behavior changed.
- [ ] I removed temporary Sandboxes created for testing.
- [ ] The change contains no credentials, private source, local paths, or generated plugin state.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and compatibility changes are documented.
